A simple visual "clause map" diagram. Top box: the full sentence "When the rain stopped, the children who were waiting ran outside." Below it, coloured brackets: a blue bracket under "the children ... ran outside" marked as the main clause; an orange bracket under "When the rain stopped" marked as the adverbial clause of time; a green bracket under "who were waiting" marked as the adjective (relative) clause, with an arrow from it pointing up to the noun "children".
